purpose: Define repository-wide validation of Topic membership, multi-Topic classification, inheritance, composition and explicit outsider state.

topics.name: Topic Validation
topics.purpose: Define repository-wide validation of Topic membership, multi-Topic classification, inheritance, composition and explicit outsider state.

semantics.coverage_rule: Every machine-significant canonical node resolves to one or more Topics or explicit outsider.
semantics.multi_rule: Validator preserves all applicable Topic memberships and never selects one canonical preferred Topic by default.
semantics.composition_rule: Composed Topics retain all component traceability.
semantics.outsider_rule: Outsiders remain visible validation findings with reasons.
semantics.locality_rule: Topic information must be discoverable with the semantic nodes/subtrees it classifies according to the 1.4 Topic model.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: node has no Topic and no outsider classification
Topic semantics require disconnected undocumented lookup heuristic

prose.summary: Define repository-wide validation of Topic membership, multi-Topic classification, inheritance, composition and explicit outsider state.
notes: Unlocked until exercised against the complete assembled Contract Format 1.4 tree.
